whenToUse: Use designsetgo/row for a horizontal group of items that should wrap or stack responsively — CTA button groups, badge rows, a hero's action buttons, or a horizontal strip of small cards. It's DesignSetGo's replacement for core/group with a flex layout.
avoid: Do not add 3 or more items to a row without either enabling mobileStack or allowing the layout to wrap — a nowrap row with 3+ children will overflow on small screens.
Do not use raw pixel/rem gaps in style.spacing.blockGap — use a theme spacing preset (e.g. "var:preset|spacing|30") so the gap follows the design system.
Do not reach for core/group with a flex layout instead — use designsetgo/row, which is the project's dedicated horizontal layout block.
Do not leave a row with no innerBlocks — an empty row renders as dead space.
